Tab Vault v1.0.1

Save browser groups. Close the clutter.

Open tab groups

Workspaces (all windows)

Save the grouped tabs across multiple monitors as one workspace. Restore the entire workspace, a single saved window, or one tab group. New-window placement is best-effort.

Closed saved groups

Saved workspace groups not currently found as matching live tab groups. A partial group stays in its workspace list. Click Refresh to check again.

Saved groups

Duplicate review

Inspect repeated URLs within groups and URLs appearing in multiple collections. Never removes anything.

Automatic snapshots

Opt-in, while the browser is running. Keeps up to 3 automatic versions per group name/color. Never closes tabs.

Privacy
Local storage; saved URLs are not encrypted

Open-source local-first browser extension created by Seth Egger. Source code and documentation are available on GitHub under the MIT License.

Local-only · URLs are not encrypted · Export backups regularly. Saved tabs restore URLs, not unsaved forms or page state.
